note: Journey data shared by the browser prototype and, later, the Godot game: regions in travel order, items, shop sizes. Text is Slovene. Edit by hand, then run tools/art_extra.py (item icons) and build.py. Potions and poisons are used automatically; `when` names the trigger (start of a battle, a hurt hero, a fallen hero, locked letters).
checkpointsNote: Where the journey is saved, by Znanje: after the last battle of these regions. Malček every quarter of the road, Učenjak every third, Knjižni molj once, at the half (after the shrines at Bled). Counted in battles (19 on the road), rounded to the nearest region end.
chanceNote: Every region has one event slot (`event` in its stops): a chest or a trap, never both (Game Director, 20 Nov 2026). When a journey starts, each slot becomes a chest with the chance `chest` by Znanje, else a trap: a rock slide or a wall of spikes, half and half (`traps`). Ptuj's is always a chest (`firstChest`). Wells are there by chance (`well`): a journey always keeps at least one well in each half of the road.
balanceNote: Balance E (20 Nov 2026), from the road simulations of the real game (tools/sim, docs/progression-design.md §4c): softer first regions, a steeper second half, and tougher bosses, so that a Malček player at a word every 10 s loses about half of the journeys. hp / atk: enemy health and attack by region, in travel order (bosses keep their own numbers, and so do the Lintvern's wyverns; the vile beside Povodni mož grow with the region). thirdFrom: from this region on a battle has a third enemy once the party has three or more heroes. single: at most one of these in one battle. strong: from this region on, in this share of battles one enemy is strong (Silni …, Silna …), with more health and harder hits. steep: by Znanje, how much more health and how much faster attacks ordinary enemies have by the last region, growing region by region. A region's `sizes` fixes how many enemies its battles have, in order. Ptuj is the same on every Znanje (Malček's enemy health) and a lost battle there never ends the journey. escort (Ljubljanica, Game Director 20 Nov 2026): in the boss battle the vile beside Povodni mož hit weaker (atk ×) and every third move (pattern) heal him for `heal` of his health while they and he stand.
